                Kyle Katarn With Jacket

                I find this file several years later, it is simple but very cool. I guess it could have been a good skin for the mission on Vjun, as he uses another layer against the rain (while I know he already uses Force protection). Because Tatooine and Taspir are too hot to take a jacket, he stays in the Raven's Claw on Corellia, I don't think it's really useful in the dreadnought (not useless either), and we don't share missions with him seen otherwise.

              4. 6

                Cinema v3

                I know the mapmaker, and am happy to say this is his best work yet. Apart from being a 5/5 map in terms of design and mood, the map is more than it seems. Without spoiling too much, it's a last hoorah from a dead JK clan and commemorates one of the most progressive, inclusive, and welcoming clans I had the privilege of leading for a brief span of 18 years. A group of people I can only describe as cosmopolitan, open-minded and welcoming. The map, in the author's own words to me, is this clan's last mark and gift to the JK community and the game that fortunately brought us all together, gave us and taught us so much.

            This is JKHub.

            This community is dedicated to the games Star Wars: Jedi Outcast (2002) and Jedi Academy (2003). We host over 3,000 mods created by passionate fans around the world, and thousands of threads of people showcasing their works in progress and asking for assistance.

            From mods to art to troubleshooting help, we probably have it. If we don't, request or contribute!

            Good places to get started is our links page below, or just take a look around!
